captures_note: captures are taken immediately after each pass; grabbing during a pass would stall the delivered cadence this scenario measures

reopened_cache.ordered_replay_window_note: a reopened session has no in-memory demand records, so the ordered window's replay entry point cannot serve it: the probes go through the panel's request path, and published == 0 proves no live frame was produced for them
reopened_cache.seam: worker session replaced by the colour-configuration identity a request states (ViewerRuntime::describe with an alternate path)

scenario: cached 1080p range, ordered playback window, forward and reverse
timestamp_boundary: GUI receipt of real destination-scoped Qt frameSwapped notifications; includes queued delivery jitter, not physical scanout
